headline: FGC Reports Data Breach Affecting Investor Information
summary: The Fundo Garantidor de Créditos (FGC) in Brazil detected unauthorized access to its systems on October 26. The organization has notified the national data protection authority and warned investors to be vigilant against potential fraud.
why: The FGC is a private entity that protects bank depositors in Brazil. A data breach at such an institution poses significant security risks to the financial system and investor trust.
